subject: Operations
title: Circular Supply Chains
description: A short lesson to help you apply Circular Supply Chains.

hook.text: A phone is used for two years and landfilled. Its materials took millions of years to form. That's a linear waste.

buildup.text: Linear supply chains take, make, and dispose. Circular ones recover, refurbish, and reuse materials.

discovery.text: Design for disassembly, take-back programs, and material recovery loops close the circle.

twist.text: Circularity requires redesigning products from the start. Retrofitting linear products into circular systems is hard.

climax.text: Apple recovers gold, cobalt, and rare earths from old iPhones using Daisy, a robot that disassembles 200 per hour.

punchline.text: Waste is a design flaw, not an inevitability.

quiz.question: What does a circular supply chain do with old products?
